existing.name: Narmada Riverside Camp
existing.issue: fabricated — 'Narmada Riverside Camp' on the Narmada floodplain with bonfire dinners is not in Mandu. The Narmada is 30+ km away through the Maan valley below the Mandu plateau (Mandu itself sits at 634m on a plateau with no river). Cross-dest confusion with Maheshwar (75 km) or Omkareshwar (where Narmada Resort sits). Honest scarcity for Mandu xfactor — no plateau-tent / boutique-luxury / camp infrastructure exists. The plateau is dense with monuments but thin on hotel innovation.
